title: Harden message origin checks and rich-text URL sanitization

target.summary: getExpectedPreviewOrigin derives the expected origin from the input preview URL, allowing an off-origin or absolute URL to be treated as trusted. As a result, isFromTrustedPreviewOrigin accepts messages from untrusted external origins and postMessageToPreview leaks preview data to them.
notes: faulty statement deriving expected preview origin from the input URL
call site invoking getExpectedPreviewOrigin with the preview url to determine expectedOrigin
